_comment: Golden vectors for the client-side RewriteCache key, shared by macOS (Swift), Windows (C#) and Linux (Python). This file is the ONE source of truth; each platform's test asserts its key()/Key()/_key() reproduces every expectedKey below. RULE #1: the three impls are the same logic in three languages and cannot be merged, so a machine — not a comment — must prove they agree. Guards issues #147, #108, #174. Key format: '{language}::{tone}::{text}', with the language prefix omitted when language is null OR empty. No escaping is applied to '::' inside text — that is intentional and identical across platforms; these vectors pin it.
